scanNote:
GRAMMAR 27-BET. Unit 6 — savol so'zlari va ko'plik shakllari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 2-mashq (5 savol + 5 moslash), 3-mashq (13 savol so'zi), 4-mashq (23 ta ko'plik) — jami 46 ta javob.

⚠ 4-MAShQ — HISOB TO'G'RI KELADI: ro'yxatda 23 so'z bor va uchala quti to'ldirilganda ham 23 chiqadi:
  -S (7 ta): students, chairs, beds, koalas, penguins, dolphins, tigers
  -ES (6 ta): actresses, buses, pouches, brushes, addresses, benches
  NOTO'G'RI (10 ta): teeth, mice, sheep, children, men, deer, feet, fish, women, geese
  ⚠ Bu — o'zini tekshirishning oson yo'li.
  ⚠ '-es' qutisiga tushganlarning hammasi '-ss', '-sh', '-ch' yoki '-s' bilan tugaydi.
  ⚠ 'sheep', 'deer', 'fish' NOTO'G'RI qutisida, chunki ular umuman O'ZGARMAYDI.

⚠ 3-MAShQ — IKKI ChALKAShTIRUVChI JUFTLIK:
  'WHOSE are these glasses?' → 'Paul's' (kimning) va 'WHO are you?' → 'I'm Tom' (kim)
  'HOW are the children?' → 'They're fine' (ahvoli) va 'HOW OFTEN do you wash?' → 'Once a week' (chastota)
  ⚠ 6 va 12-bandda 'WHAT animals...' — 'which' emas, chunki tanlov cheklanmagan.

⚠ 2-MAShQ — TULKI HAQIDAGI FAKTLAR: qizil tulki Shimoliy Amerika, Osiyo, Yevropa va Afrikada yashaydi; sichqon, quyon, tuxum, meva va qush yeydi; 6 kilo keladi; 4 oyoq; 2 yil yashaydi.
  ⚠ Tabiatdagi qizil tulki odatda 3-4 yil yashaydi, kitobdagi '2 years' ham haqiqatga yaqin.

sections.title: Question words with a fox fact file

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct question words from the list. Then, match the questions to the answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri so'roq so'zlarini qo'ying. So'ng savollarni javoblarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: what, how much, where, how long, how many

RASMDA: qorda yurgan yovvoyi QIZIL TULKI (a wild red fox).

JAVOBLAR:
  a  6 kilos.
  b  Four.
  c  2 years.
  d  In North America, Asia, Europe and Africa.
  e  Mice, rabbits, eggs, fruit and birds.

DIQQAT: javob 'Mice' — 'mouse' ning noto'g'ri ko'pligi (26-bet).

items.textEn: 1  "............ does a wild red fox live?"
items.hintUz: Javobi: 'In North America, Asia, Europe and Africa'
items.whyUz:
Javob JOY → WHERE.
DIQQAT: 5-savol ham 'live' bilan, lekin u DAVOMIYLIK so'raydi.

items.hintUz: Javobi: 'Mice, rabbits, eggs, fruit and birds'

items.whyUz: Og'irlik → HOW MUCH ('weigh' fe'li bilan doim shu).

'legs' — SANALADIGAN ot → HOW MANY.
'has it got' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

Javob YIL (davomiylik) → HOW LONG.
1-savoldan farqi: bu yerda JOY emas, VAQT so'ralyapti.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
TULKI HAQIDA FAKTLAR:
  • Qizil tulki Shimoliy Amerika, Osiyo, Yevropa va Afrikada yashaydi
  • Sichqon, quyon, tuxum, meva va qush yeydi
  • Taxminan 6 kilo keladi
  • To'rtta oyog'i bor
  • Taxminan 2 yil yashaydi (yovvoyi tabiatda)

pairs.left: 1  Where does a wild red fox live?
pairs.right: d  In North America, Asia, Europe and Africa.
pairs.rightUz: Shimoliy Amerika, Osiyo, Yevropa va Afrikada.

pairs.right: e  Mice, rabbits, eggs, fruit and birds.
pairs.rightUz: Sichqon, quyon, tuxum, meva va qush.
pairs.whyUz:
Ovqat savoliga ovqat ro'yxati.
'mice' = sichqonlar (mouse → mice).

pairs.left: 4  How many legs has it got?
pairs.whyUz: Son savoliga son javobi. Tulki — sutemizuvchi, to'rt oyoqli.
Davomiylik savoliga yil javobi. Yovvoyi tulki juda kam yashaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in who, what, which, where, how long, when, what, how often, how or whose.
exercises.instructionUz: who, what, which, where, how long, when, what, how often, how yoki whose so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI YANGI SO'ROQ SO'ZI:

  WHOSE — kimniki? (egalik)
     Whose cat is that? — It's mine.
     Whose are these glasses? — Paul's.
     DIQQAT: 'who's' (= who is) bilan CHALKASHTIRMANG!
       Whose = kimniki (egalik)
       Who's = kim (who is qisqartmasi)
     Ikkalasi bir xil o'qiladi: /huːz/

  WHICH — qaysi biri? (CHEKLANGAN tanlovdan)
     Which colour do you like, red or blue?
     WHAT esa CHEKSIZ tanlovdan so'raydi:
     What colour do you like?

YANA:
  How are you/they? — Ahvol so'raydi (javob: fine, OK).
     Bu 'How do you ...?' (usul) dan FARQ qiladi.

items.whyUz:
Javob 'Paul's' (Polniki) — EGALIK → WHOSE.
'glasses' = ko'zoynak (doim ko'plik) yoki stakanlar.

items.textEn: 2  A: "............ do dolphins live?"  B: "About fifty years."
items.whyUz:
'About fifty years' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
Coursebook 40-betdagi delfin matni bilan bir xil fakt.

items.textEn: 3  A: "............ do tigers eat?"  B: "Deer and monkeys."

items.whyUz:
Javob ODAM ismi → WHO.
DIQQAT: 'How are you?' bo'lsa javob 'I'm fine' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 5  A: "............ are the children?"  B: "They're fine."
items.whyUz:
Javob AHVOL ('fine') → HOW.
4-savoldan farqini solishtiring: Who are you? / How are you?
'children' — 'child' ning noto'g'ri ko'pligi.

items.textEn: 6  A: "............ animals do you like?"  B: "Dogs and cats."
items.whyUz:
Tanlov CHEKSIZ (dunyodagi hamma hayvon) → WHAT animals.
DIQQAT: 'Which animals ...?' ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri —
lekin u CHEKLANGAN ro'yxatdan tanlashni bildiradi
(masalan, rasmda 5 ta hayvon bo'lsa).

items.textEn: 7  A: "............ do kangaroos sleep?"  B: "During the day."
items.whyUz:
'During the day' — VAQT → WHEN.
Coursebook 43-betdagi kenguru matnidan.

items.textEn: 8  A: "............ do koalas live?"  B: "In eastern Australia."
items.whyUz:
'In eastern Australia' — JOY → WHERE.
Coursebook 42-betdagi koala matnidan.

items.textEn: 9  A: "............ colour is an elephant?"  B: "Grey."
items.whyUz:
'What colour ...?' — o'zgarmas ibora.
Fil kulrang — Coursebook 43-betdagi rasmda ko'rgansiz.

items.textEn: 10  A: "............ do you wash your dog?"  B: "Once a week."
items.whyUz:
'Once a week' — CHASTOTA → HOW OFTEN.
'to wash' = yuvmoq.

items.textEn: 11  A: "............ tall is your brother?"  B: "About 1.80 metres."
items.whyUz:
'How + sifat' = o'lchov savoli: How TALL ...?
Javob metrda beriladi.

items.textEn: 12  A: "............ is that animal?"  B: "It's a sea lion."
items.whyUz:
Hayvon nomi (narsa) → WHAT.
DIQQAT: odam bo'lsa WHO bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 13  A: "............ cat is that?"  B: "It's mine."
items.whyUz:
Javob 'mine' (meniki) — EGALIK → WHOSE.
'Whose + ot' tartibi: Whose CAT is that?

exercises.instructionEn: Write the words in plural in the correct box, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni ko'plikda to'g'ri katakka yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR (23 ta): student, actress, tooth, chair, bus, mouse, bed,
pouch, brush, koala, sheep, address, child, penguin, dolphin,
man, bench, deer, tiger, foot, fish, woman, goose

UCH KATAK:

  -S KATAGI — oddiy otlar (7 ta)
     Oxiri tinch undosh yoki unli bo'lsa, faqat -s qo'shiladi.
     NAMUNA: students

  -ES KATAGI — quyidagilar bilan tugaganda (6 ta)
     -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o
     Sabab: bu tovushlardan keyin -s ni talaffuz qilib bo'lmaydi,
     shuning uchun /ɪz/ tovushi qo'shiladi.
     NAMUNA: actresses

  IRREGULAR KATAGI — noto'g'ri otlar (10 ta)
     Yo o'zak o'zgaradi, yo shakl umuman o'zgarmaydi.
     NAMUNA: teeth

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. -t bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.

fish → fish.
DIQQAT: -sh bilan tugasa ham -ES OLMAYDI, chunki u NOTO'G'RI ot.
('fishes' faqat turli TURLARI haqida.)

items.hintUz: Yozilishi bir harf, talaffuzi boshqacha o'zgaradi

wordFormation.introUz: 27-bet — ko'plik yasashning uch yo'li va yangi so'roq so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ot tinch undosh yoki unli bilan tugasa, faqat -s qo'shiladi.
Bu tovushlardan keyin qo'shimcha /ɪz/ bo'g'ini qo'shiladi.

groups.ruleUz: WHOSE va WHO'S — bir xil o'qiladi, boshqa ma'no
groups.explanationUz: Ikkalasi ham /huːz/ deb o'qiladi. Ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.

items.derived: Which animal, the cat or the dog?

patterns.formula: WHOSE + ot + is/are + this/that/these?  — It's/They're + egalik.
patterns.exampleEn: Whose cat is that? — It's mine. Whose are these glasses? — Paul's.
patterns.exampleUz: U kimning mushugi? — Meniki. Bular kimning ko'zoynagi? — Polniki.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Whose' dan keyin ot kelishi ham, kelmasligi ham mumkin.
Javobda egalik olmoshi (mine, yours) yoki ism + 's.

patterns.exampleEn: How tall is your brother? — About 1.80 metres.
How are the children? — They're fine.
patterns.explanationUz:
'How are ...?' — SOG'LIQ/AHVOL so'raydi.
'How do you ...?' esa USUL so'raydi. Aralashtirmang.

patterns.exampleEn: What animals do you like? — Dogs and cats.
patterns.exampleUz: Qanday hayvonlarni yoqtirasiz? — It va mushuklarni.
patterns.explanationUz: 'What' otga birikadi va o'sha ot bo'yicha savol beradi.

Avval oxirgi harflarga qarang:
  -s/-ss/-sh/-ch/-x/-o → -ES
  noto'g'ri ro'yxatda bormi → NOTO'G'RI SHAKL
  aks holda → -S
